deadline_protection.step_gate: a step starts only when the driver's deadline covers its whole registered bound (step_bounds_s)

arithmetic.what: the float32 computation against float64: the teacher Top-K + tail KL and the union KL, each per position |d| <= abs + rel x KL64, against a float64 oracle on the float32-head teacher distribution and the same candidate logits; the float64 order KL_T <= KL_U <= KL_full at the float64 slack; float32 crossings of that order within the combined bound (count beyond it: 0); retrieval against the full head's log-softmax; the K+1 confidence against float64 on the same sketch; the c x KL item mean; the raw-KL control inside ONE version-3 evaluation

kl_error_budget.compared: KL_T and KL_U as union_forward_kl_terms reduces them in float32 from the root store's teacher inputs (sketch, tail, retrieved entries) and the candidate's logits, against the float64 oracle on the float32 head logits recomputed from the store's hidden state and the same candidate logits

sources.log_softmax_rounding: z - logsumexp(z) in float32: about eps (|z - max| + log sum) per entry, <= ~2e-5 nats for logits spanning <= 80 nats
sources.teacher_input_path: the store forms its sketch per 512-row block and candidate-only entries through the head's row gather; the oracle recomputes the head per item. Per entry this is bounded by the retrieval tolerance. KL_T reads no retrieved entry and no subtraction
sources.reduction: float32 sums over <= 2K+1 buckets: <= (2K+1) eps sum|terms| worst case, ~sqrt(2K+1) eps sum|terms| typical
sources.union_tail: p_tail_U = tail_T - sum_E p (log1mexp): its absolute error is <= d * tail_T for a relative input error d, entering KL_U as at most d * tail_T * (1 + |log p_tail_U / q_tail_U|)

kl_error_budget.propagation: a teacher log-probability error d per bucket moves the KL by p (1 + log p/q) d, at most d (3 + KL) in total because sum p |log p/q| <= KL + 2; a candidate error d moves it by at most d
kl_error_budget.tolerance: abs 1e-4 + rel 1e-4 x KL64 for BOTH partitions. KL_U's value was registered before revision 1 and held at all 46,056 positions there; KL_T takes the same value because its float32 sources are a subset of KL_U's (no retrieved entry, no tail subtraction)
kl_error_budget.fp64_bounds: coarser partition <= finer <= full is exact; float64 tree summation errs by <= ~log2|V| x 2.2e-16 x (KL + 2), so 1e-12 x (1 + KL_full) is a ~250x margin
kl_error_budget.crossings: lower KL32_T - KL32_U <= tol_T + tol_U + slack and upper KL32_U - KL64_full <= tol_U + slack follow from the two accuracy gates and the exact float64 order; a crossing beyond its bound is an anomaly, counted rather than assumed away
kl_error_budget.not_assumed: no slack is derived from one log-normalizer alone

arithmetic.recorded_per_position: per side: crossing counts, the largest crossing with its float64 values, beyond-bound counts; per partition: error distributions and error/tolerance histograms over every position; full records of every crossing and every position above half a tolerance (capped, the cap stated); a same-input attribution separating float32 rounding from the store's teacher-input path; anomalies = float64 violations + crossings beyond the bound + finiteness mismatches
arithmetic.teacher_distribution: the float32 head distribution the root store defines -- never the native bf16 logits

scientific_decision_rubric.status: a RECOMMENDATION rubric for the maintainer's decision on preregistration v3; never a code gate, never a reason to change K, the mapping, the tail formula or the support
scientific_decision_rubric.reference_point: version 2 on the same teacher and mixtures (Stage V): c_T IQR 0.042-0.055, ESS fraction >= 0.994, weighted vs unweighted root-KL DEPTH ranking rho 0.999 with the same choice, weighted objective 96-97% of the raw KL

signals.weighting: W1: the K+1 c_T IQR and ESS fraction over scored positions per profile; W3: the weighted share against the unweighted share by span, domain and critical token; W4: weighted vs unweighted union-KL ranking (rho, same choice, top-3)
signals.support: W3: union / full and teacher-Top-K / full KL ratios, union size and overlap; W4: union vs teacher-Top-K ranking (rho, same choice)
signals.reference: W4: parent vs root rankings (version 2 already showed rho 0.816 and a different choice)

scientific_decision_rubric.GO: validation PASS, and at least one of: the weighted and unweighted union-KL DEPTH choices differ; their ranking rho < 0.95; the K+1 c_T IQR at least twice version 2's (>= 0.11) on both profiles. Then version 3 tests more than the root reference, and the full search is recommended for the maintainer's approval
scientific_decision_rubric.HOLD: validation PASS but the weighting is as inert as version 2's: IQR <= 0.06 on both profiles, ESS fraction >= 0.99, weighted vs unweighted rho >= 0.99 with the same choice. Then a version-3 search would mainly test the root reference and the union support; the recommendation is an explicit maintainer decision between running it with that claim boundary and stopping D2 -- NOT a further redefinition of the confidence
scientific_decision_rubric.between: any other PASS: reported as measured with both readings; the maintainer decides
scientific_decision_rubric.NO-GO: validation FAIL on arithmetic or integrity that a root-caused engineering repair cannot clear: version 3 is not measurable as defined
